svg.text: Request flow: Browser → Open Web UI → Pipeline Proxy → RAG Backend → Qdrant / vLLM
Routes all chat via OPENAI_API_BASE_URL = http://pipelines:9099
Loads Valves from valves.json · self.id = "mintify_pipeline" · self.type = "manifold"
Valve fields: BACKEND_URL · TOP_K · SYSTEM_PROMPT (with {context} placeholder)
→ GET /api/health on RAG backend to confirm readiness (non-fatal if down)
→ GET /api/models · sanitizes IDs ("/" → "__") · populates OWUI model dropdown
2. Build payload (user_message, model_id, messages, temperature, system_prompt, top_k)
3. httpx.stream("POST", BACKEND_URL/api/pipe) · timeout=120 s · yield each text chunk to OWUI
routers/rag.py — POST /api/pipe (executed on every chat message)
Hash-check each PDF · skip known · new files: fitz.open() → _chunk_text(800 chars, 100 overlap)
→ embedder.encode(chunk) → 384-dim vector → qdrant.upsert() IDs: int(md5,16) % 2^53 + page×1000 + i
SentenceTransformer(all-MiniLM-L6-v2).encode(text).tolist() — same model as indexing → matching vector space
qdrant.get_collection() → check count · qdrant.query_points(collection, query_vec, limit=top_k)

Format per hit: "[Quelle: file.pdf, Seite 3, Relevanz 0.84]
<chunk>" joined with "

---

"
Fills {context} placeholder · prepends enriched system message · strips any existing system message from history
yield delta tokens → StreamingResponse → httpx.iter_text() → Pipeline pipe() → OWUI → Browser
llm_client.refresh_model_map() → GET {vllm_url}/v1/models on each configured URL → rebuilds { model_id: url }
Returns: [{"id": "Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B", "name": " – Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B"}] (raw HF IDs — pipeline sanitizes "/" → "__")
Service Singletons — injected via FastAPI Depends()
vllm_base_urls · qdrant_url · collection_name · embedding_model · upload_dir · chunk_size(800) · chunk_overlap(100) · top_k(5)
L-shaped arrows follow box edges to avoid overlap
Streaming response flows back along the same path
